title: Request annual leave
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **My leave**.
2. Select **Request leave**.
3. Choose **Annual leave** from the **Leave type** list.
4. Pick your **Start date** and **End date**.
5. Check the **Hours requested** total, which updates automatically.
6. Add a message for your manager if you wish.
7. Select **Submit request**.

Your manager is notified straight away and you will get an email when they respond.

title: Cancel a leave request
aliases: I don't need the days off any more
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **My leave**.
2. Open the **Requests** tab.
3. Find the request you want to cancel and select it.
4. Select **Cancel request**.
5. Confirm by selecting **Yes, cancel**.

If the leave was already approved, the hours go back into your balance and your manager is told about the change.

title: Approve a leave request
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the **Pending** tab.
3. Select the request to see the dates, hours and the employee's remaining balance.
4. Check the **Team calendar** panel for clashes.
5. Select **Approve**.

The employee is emailed and the leave appears on the team calendar.

title: Decline a leave request
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the **Pending** tab and select the request.
3. Select **Decline**.
4. Enter a reason in the **Message to employee** box. This is required.
5. Select **Confirm decline**.

The employee is emailed your reason and their balance is left unchanged.

title: Check your leave balance
aliases: how much leave do I have
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **My leave**.
2. Look at the **Balances** panel at the top of the page.
3. Select a leave type to see its history, including accruals and leave taken.
4. Turn on **Show projected balance** and choose a future date to see what you will have by then.

Balances are shown in hours. Select **Show in days** to switch the view.

title: Add a leave type
aliases: create a new kind of leave
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Leave**.
2. Select **Leave types**, then **Add leave type**.
3. Enter a **Name**, such as Study leave.
4. Choose whether the leave is **Paid** or **Unpaid**.
5. Choose whether it **Accrues** over time or is a **Fixed allowance**.
6. Select the employees or groups it applies to.
7. Select **Save**.

title: Adjust an employee's leave balance
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select the **Leave** tab.
3. Select **Adjust balance** next to the leave type.
4. Enter the number of hours to add or remove.
5. Enter a **Reason**. It is saved in the audit history.
6. Select **Apply adjustment**.

title: Set the leave accrual rate
aliases: change how fast leave builds up
how many hours of leave per pay run
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Leave**.
2. Select **Leave types** and open the leave type.
3. Under **Accrual**, choose **Per hour worked** or **Per pay run**.
4. Enter the **Hours accrued**.
5. Set a **Maximum balance** if you want a cap.
6. Select **Save**.

Changes apply from the next pay run and do not alter past balances.

title: Add a leave request for an employee
aliases: enter leave for my team member
log leave on behalf of staff
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **Approvals**.
2. Select **New request**.
3. Search for and select the **Employee**.
4. Choose the **Leave type** and enter the dates.
5. Turn on **Approve immediately** if no approval is needed.
6. Select **Submit**.

title: View the team leave calendar
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **Team calendar**.
2. Use **Week**, **Month** or **Quarter** to change the view.
3. Select **Filter** and choose a **Department** or **Location**.
4. Hover over a coloured bar to see the employee, dates and leave type.

Pending requests appear striped, and approved leave appears solid.

title: Export a leave report to CSV
aliases: get leave taken as a file
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **Reports**.
2. Choose **Leave balances** or **Leave taken**.
3. Set the **Date range** and any **Department** filter.
4. Select **Run report**.
5. Select **Export** and choose **CSV**.

The file downloads to your browser's usual downloads folder.

title: Add a note to a leave request
aliases: write a remark on time off
leave a message on someone's leave
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the request you want to comment on.
3. Select the **Notes** tab.
4. Type your comment in the box.
5. Choose **Visible to employee** or **Managers only**.
6. Select **Add note**.

title: Request half a day of leave
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **My leave**.
2. Select **Request leave**.
3. Choose the **Leave type**.
4. Pick the date and turn on **Partial day**.
5. Enter the **Start time** and **End time**, or the number of hours.
6. Select **Submit request**.

The hours are deducted from your balance once the request is approved.

title: Set up leave carry-over rules
aliases: use it or lose it leave
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Leave**.
2. Open the leave type you want to change.
3. Select **Carry-over**.
4. Choose **Carry over all**, **Carry over up to a limit** or **Reset to zero**.
5. If you chose a limit, enter the maximum **Hours**.
6. Select the **Rollover date**.
7. Select **Save**.

title: Attach a medical certificate to sick leave
body:
1. Go to **Leave** and select **My leave**.
2. Open the sick leave request from the **Requests** tab.
3. Select **Add attachment**.
4. Choose a PDF or image file from your device.
5. Select **Upload**, then **Save**.

Only you, your manager and payroll administrators can see the attachment.

title: Process a leave cash-out
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Leave cash-outs**.
2. Select **New cash-out**.
3. Search for and select the **Employee**.
4. Enter the **Hours** to pay out. The remaining balance is shown.
5. Choose the **Pay run** the payment will be included in.
6. Select **Save**.

The hours are deducted when the pay run is finalised.

title: Delete a leave type
aliases: get rid of old leave type
body:
You can only delete a leave type that has no leave booked against it. Otherwise, archive it.

1. Go to **Settings** and select **Leave**.
2. Select **Leave types**.
3. Open the leave type.
4. Select **Delete leave type** and confirm.

To keep the history, select **Archive** instead. Archived types cannot be chosen for new requests.

title: Start a pay run
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Select **New pay run**.
3. Choose the **Pay schedule**.
4. Check the **Pay period** and **Payment date**.
5. Select **Create draft**.
6. Review each employee's hours and earnings.
7. Select **Finalise** when everything looks right.

Finalising locks the pay run and generates payslips.

title: View a payslip
aliases: check how much I was paid
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **My payslips**.
2. Select the payslip for the pay date you want.
3. Review the **Earnings**, **Tax**, **Super** and **Net pay** sections.
4. Select **Year to date** to compare totals.

You can review the result in the pay run summary before anything is paid.

title: Download a payslip as a PDF
aliases: get a copy of my pay slip
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **My payslips**.
2. Open the payslip you need.
3. Select **Download PDF**.
4. Save the file to your device.

You can download any payslip from the last seven years.

You can review the result in the pay run summary before anything is paid.

title: Email payslips to employees
aliases: employee did not get their payslip
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Open a finalised pay run.
3. Select the **Payslips** tab.
4. Tick the employees to send to, or tick **Select all**.
5. Select **Email payslips**.
6. Select **Send**.

Each email goes to the employee's work email address on their profile.

title: Update an employee's bank details
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select the **Pay** tab.
3. Under **Bank accounts**, select **Edit**.
4. Enter the **BSB**, **Account number** and **Account name**.
5. Choose how much of their pay goes into the account.
6. Select **Save**.

The new account is used from the next pay run.

title: Update an employee's tax details
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select the **Pay** tab, then **Tax**.
3. Select **Edit**.
4. Enter the **Tax file number**.
5. Update the residency status and tax-free threshold answers.
6. Select **Save**.

Only payroll administrators can see the full tax file number.

title: Update an employee's super fund
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select the **Pay** tab, then **Superannuation**.
3. Select **Add fund** or **Change fund**.
4. Search by fund name or enter the **USI** and **Member number**.
5. Select **Save**.

Super contributions use the new fund from the next pay run.

title: Add an allowance to an employee
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select the **Pay** tab, then **Pay items**.
3. Select **Add pay item**.
4. Choose the **Allowance** category and pick the item.
5. Enter the **Amount** and how often it is paid.
6. Set the **Start date**.
7. Select **Save**.

title: Add a one-off bonus to a pay run
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and open the draft pay run.
2. Select the employee's row.
3. Select **Add earnings line**.
4. Choose **Bonus** as the pay item.
5. Enter the **Amount**.
6. Select **Save**.

The bonus is included in this pay run only.

title: Correct a finalised pay run
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Open the finalised pay run.
3. Select **More**, then **Reverse pay run**.
4. Enter a **Reason**.
5. Select **Reverse**.
6. Create a new pay run with the correct figures.

Reversing is not possible once the payment file has been sent to the bank.

title: Delete a draft pay run
aliases: cancel a pay run I started
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Open the pay run marked **Draft**.
3. Select **More**, then **Delete draft**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.

Finalised pay runs cannot be deleted. Reverse them instead.

You can review the result in the pay run summary before anything is paid.

title: Export a pay run to CSV
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Open the pay run.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV** and select the **Summary** or **Detailed** layout.
5. Select **Download**.

You can review the result in the pay run summary before anything is paid.

title: Set up a pay schedule
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Payroll**.
2. Select **Pay schedules**, then **Add schedule**.
3. Enter a **Name**.
4. Choose the **Frequency**: weekly, fortnightly or monthly.
5. Select the **First pay date**.
6. Select the employees on this schedule.
7. Select **Save**.

title: Add a note to a pay run
aliases: leave a remark on a pay run
record why a pay run changed
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Open the pay run.
3. Select the **Notes** tab.
4. Type your note.
5. Select **Add note**.

Notes are visible to payroll administrators only.

You can review the result in the pay run summary before anything is paid.

title: Mark a pay run as paid
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and select **Pay runs**.
2. Open a finalised pay run with the status **Awaiting payment**.
3. Select **Change status**.
4. Choose **Paid**.
5. Enter the date the money left your bank account.
6. Select **Save**.

You can review the result in the pay run summary before anything is paid.

title: Process a final pay
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select **More**, then **End employment**.
3. Enter the **Last day of work** and the **Reason**.
4. Select **Calculate final pay**.
5. Review the unused leave payout and any other amounts.
6. Select **Add to pay run**.

title: Enter hours on your timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **My timesheet**.
2. Select the week using the arrows at the top.
3. Select **Add entry** on the day you worked.
4. Enter the **Start time** and **End time**.
5. Choose the **Project** if one applies.
6. Select **Save**.

Your hours are saved as a draft until you submit them.

title: Submit a timesheet for approval
aliases: send my timesheet to my manager
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **My timesheet**.
2. Check that every day shows the correct hours.
3. Select **Submit for approval**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Submit**.

The status changes from **Draft** to **Submitted**.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Approve a timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Approvals**.
2. Select a timesheet marked **Submitted**.
3. Check the daily totals and any notes.
4. Select **Approve**.

Approved hours flow into the next pay run automatically.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Reject a timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the submitted timesheet.
3. Select **Reject**.
4. Enter what needs to change in the **Reason** box.
5. Select **Send back**.

The employee is emailed and can edit and resubmit.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Recall a submitted timesheet
aliases: I made a mistake after submitting
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **My timesheet**.
2. Open the week you submitted.
3. Select **Recall**.
4. Make your changes.
5. Select **Submit for approval** again.

You can only recall a timesheet that has not been approved yet.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Add a note to a timesheet entry
aliases: write a remark on a time entry
leave a note on a shift
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **My timesheet**.
2. Select the entry you want to explain.
3. Select **Add note**.
4. Type your note, for example the reason for the overtime.
5. Select **Save**.

Your manager sees the note when they review your timesheet.

title: Clock in and out on the mobile app
aliases: start my shift on my phone
body:
1. Open the Harbour People app and tap **Time clock**.
2. Tap **Clock in** when you start work.
3. Tap **Start break** and **End break** as needed.
4. Tap **Clock out** when you finish.
5. Check the entry under **Timesheets**.

If location checks are on, allow the app to use your location.

title: Add a project code
aliases: new project to book time against
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Timesheets**.
2. Select **Projects**, then **Add project**.
3. Enter a **Name** and **Code**.
4. Choose whether it is **Billable**.
5. Select who can book time to it.
6. Select **Save**.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Delete a project code
aliases: get rid of a job code
stop time being booked to a project
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Timesheets**.
2. Select **Projects**.
3. Open the project.
4. Select **Delete project** and confirm.

If hours are already booked to the project, select **Archive** instead.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Delete a timesheet entry
aliases: clear a line on my timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **My timesheet**.
2. Select the entry you want to remove.
3. Select **Delete entry**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.

You cannot delete entries on a timesheet that has been approved.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Export timesheets to CSV
aliases: get time data in a file
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Reports**.
2. Choose **Hours by employee** or **Hours by project**.
3. Set the **Date range**.
4. Select **Run report**.
5. Select **Export**, then **CSV**.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Set overtime rules
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Timesheets**.
2. Select **Overtime**.
3. Choose **Daily**, **Weekly** or **Both** as the trigger.
4. Enter the number of hours before overtime starts.
5. Choose the **Pay rate multiplier**, such as 1.5.
6. Select **Save**.

title: Set a timesheet reminder
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Timesheets**.
2. Select **Reminders**.
3. Turn on **Remind employees to submit**.
4. Choose the **Day** and **Time**.
5. Select **Save**.

Employees who have already submitted are not reminded.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Copy last week's timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **My timesheet**.
2. Select the current week.
3. Select **More**, then **Copy previous week**.
4. Review the copied entries.
5. Adjust anything that has changed and select **Save**.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Lock a timesheet period
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Periods**.
2. Find the pay period you want to close.
3. Select **Lock**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Lock period**.

Locked periods cannot be edited. Select **Unlock** if you need to make a change.

You can check the result at any time under **Timesheets**.

title: Approve several timesheets at once
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Approvals**.
2. Tick the box next to each timesheet, or tick **Select all**.
3. Select **Approve selected**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Approve**.

Timesheets with warnings are skipped so you can review them one by one.

title: Reopen an approved timesheet
body:
1. Go to **Timesheets** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the **Approved** tab.
3. Select the timesheet.
4. Select **Change status**, then **Reopen**.
5. Enter a **Reason** and select **Save**.

You cannot reopen a timesheet that is already in a finalised pay run.

title: Create a review cycle
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Review cycles**.
2. Select **New cycle**.
3. Enter a **Name** and choose a **Template**.
4. Select the **Participants**.
5. Set the due dates for self-reviews and manager reviews.
6. Select **Launch cycle**.

Participants are emailed when the cycle launches.

title: Complete your self-review
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **My reviews**.
2. Open the review marked **Self-review due**.
3. Answer each question and choose a **Rating**.
4. Select **Save draft** to finish later.
5. Select **Submit** when you are done.

You cannot change your answers after you submit.

title: Write a manager review
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Team reviews**.
2. Open the employee's review.
3. Read their self-review.
4. Enter your comments and choose a **Rating** for each question.
5. Select **Save draft** or **Complete review**.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Add a goal
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Goals**.
2. Select **Add goal**.
3. Enter a **Title** and **Description**.
4. Set the **Due date**.
5. Choose how it is measured: **Percentage** or **Milestones**.
6. Select **Save**.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Update goal progress
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Goals**.
2. Open the goal.
3. Select **Update progress**.
4. Enter the new percentage or tick the completed milestone.
5. Add a comment if you wish.
6. Select **Save**.

Choose **Completed** from the **Status** list to close the goal.

title: Delete a goal
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Goals**.
2. Open the goal.
3. Select **More**, then **Delete goal**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.

Deleted goals are removed from any open reviews.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Request peer feedback
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Feedback**.
2. Select **Request feedback**.
3. Choose the employee the feedback is about.
4. Search for and select up to eight colleagues.
5. Choose a **Question set**.
6. Select **Send requests**.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Add a private note to a review
aliases: hidden note about an employee review
write a note employee can't see
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Team reviews**.
2. Open the review.
3. Select the **Notes** tab.
4. Type your note.
5. Choose **Managers only** as the visibility.
6. Select **Add note**.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Share a completed review with an employee
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Team reviews**.
2. Open a review with the status **Completed**.
3. Select **Share with employee**.
4. Choose whether to include your **Rating**.
5. Select **Share**.

The employee is emailed and can view the review under **My reviews**.

title: Reopen a completed review
aliases: review status back to in progress
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Review cycles**.
2. Open the cycle and select the employee's review.
3. Select **Change status**.
4. Choose **In progress**.
5. Enter a **Reason** and select **Save**.

If the review was already shared, the employee will no longer see it until you share it again.

title: Export review results to CSV
aliases: get performance data as a file
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Reports**.
2. Select **Review results**.
3. Choose the **Review cycle**.
4. Select **Run report**.
5. Select **Export**, then **CSV**.

The file opens in Excel or any spreadsheet program and includes one row for each employee in the cycle. You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Add a rating scale
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Performance**.
2. Select **Rating scales**, then **Add scale**.
3. Enter a **Name**.
4. Add each level with a **Label** and a **Score**.
5. Select **Save**.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Change a review due date
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Review cycles**.
2. Open the cycle.
3. Select **Edit dates**.
4. Choose a new date for **Self-reviews** or **Manager reviews**.
5. Select **Save**.

Employees who have not finished are emailed about the new date.

title: Create a review template
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Performance**.
2. Select **Templates**, then **New template**.
3. Enter a **Name**.
4. Select **Add question** and choose the type, such as **Rating** or **Free text**.
5. Drag questions to reorder them.
6. Select **Save**.

title: Send recognition to a colleague
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Recognition**.
2. Select **Give recognition**.
3. Search for and select a colleague.
4. Choose a **Value**, such as Teamwork.
5. Write a short message.
6. Select **Send**.

Recognition appears on the colleague's profile and in their next review.

title: Set review reminders
body:
1. Go to **Performance** and select **Review cycles**.
2. Open the cycle and select **Reminders**.
3. Turn on **Send reminders**.
4. Choose how many days before the due date to send them.
5. Select **Save**.

You can review the outcome at any time from the **Performance** page.

title: Submit an expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Select **New claim**.
3. Enter the **Date**, **Amount** and **Merchant**.
4. Choose a **Category**.
5. Attach your receipt.
6. Select **Submit for approval**.

You can add several expenses to one claim before you submit.

title: Attach a receipt to an expense
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Open the expense.
3. Select **Add receipt**.
4. Choose a photo or PDF from your device, or take a picture in the mobile app.
5. Select **Upload**.

Each receipt can be up to 10 MB.

title: Edit a draft expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Open the **Drafts** tab.
3. Select the claim.
4. Change the details you need, such as the **Amount** or **Category**.
5. Select **Save**.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Delete an expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Open the claim.
3. Select **More**, then **Delete claim**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Delete**.

You can only delete claims that are in **Draft** or **Submitted** status.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Approve an expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open a claim marked **Submitted**.
3. Check the receipt, amount and category.
4. Select **Approve**.

Approved claims are ready to be paid in the next pay run.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Reject an expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the claim.
3. Select **Reject**.
4. Enter a reason, such as a missing receipt.
5. Select **Confirm**.

The employee can edit the claim and submit it again.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Add an expense category
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Expenses**.
2. Select **Categories**, then **Add category**.
3. Enter a **Name**.
4. Choose whether a **Receipt is required**.
5. Enter the **Account code** used by your accountant.
6. Select **Save**.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Set an expense spending limit
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Expenses**.
2. Select **Categories** and open a category.
3. Under **Spending limit**, enter the **Maximum amount**.
4. Choose **Per claim** or **Per month**.
5. Choose whether to **Block** or **Warn** when the limit is passed.
6. Select **Save**.

title: Export expenses to CSV
aliases: get expense data as a file
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **Reports**.
2. Select **All claims**.
3. Set the **Date range** and **Status**.
4. Select **Run report**.
5. Select **Export**, then **CSV**.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**. Changes take effect immediately, and you can undo them at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Add a mileage claim
aliases: claim for using my own car
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Select **New claim**, then **Mileage**.
3. Enter the **Date**, **From**, **To** and the **Distance** in kilometres.
4. Choose the **Vehicle type**.
5. Check the calculated **Amount**.
6. Select **Submit for approval**.

title: Reimburse expense claims in a pay run
body:
1. Go to **Payroll** and open a draft pay run.
2. Select **Add reimbursements**.
3. Tick the approved claims to include.
4. Select **Add to pay run**.

The claims change to **Paid** when you finalise the pay run.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Add a note to an expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and open the claim.
2. Select the **Notes** tab.
3. Type your note.
4. Select **Add note**.

The approver is notified when a note is added to a submitted claim.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Mark an expense claim as paid
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **Approvals**.
2. Open the **Approved** tab.
3. Select the claim.
4. Select **Change status**, then **Paid**.
5. Enter the **Payment date** and select **Save**.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Add a company card
aliases: link a card to an employee
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Expenses**.
2. Select **Company cards**, then **Add card**.
3. Enter the **Card name** and the last four digits.
4. Select the **Cardholder**.
5. Select **Save**.

Card transactions appear on the cardholder's **My claims** page for matching.

title: Claim an expense in a foreign currency
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Select **New claim**.
3. Choose the currency from the **Currency** list.
4. Enter the **Amount** in that currency.
5. Check the **Exchange rate** and converted amount.
6. Attach the receipt and select **Submit for approval**.

title: Copy a previous expense claim
body:
1. Go to **Expenses** and select **My claims**.
2. Open the claim you want to copy.
3. Select **More**, then **Duplicate**.
4. Update the **Date** and **Amount**.
5. Attach a new receipt.
6. Select **Submit for approval**.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Set an expense approver
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Expenses**.
2. Select **Approval rules**.
3. Choose a **Department** or employee.
4. Select the **Approver**.
5. Enter a **Backup approver** if needed.
6. Select **Save**.

You can follow the progress of any claim under **Expenses**.

title: Update an employee's phone number
aliases: new phone for a staff member
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Open the employee's profile.
3. Select the **Contact** tab.
4. Select **Edit**.
5. Enter the new number in the **Mobile phone** field.
6. Select **Save**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Update an employee's email address
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Open the employee's profile.
3. Select the **Contact** tab, then **Edit**.
4. Change the **Work email** or **Personal email**.
5. Select **Save**.

If you change a work email, the employee uses the new address to sign in.

title: Add an employee
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Select **Add employee**.
3. Enter their **Name**, **Email** and **Start date**.
4. Choose a **Department** and **Manager**.
5. Select **Add pay details** to enter their rate and tax details.
6. Select **Save**.

Select **Send invitation** to let them sign in and complete their profile.

title: Delete an employee record
aliases: get rid of an employee profile
body:
Only delete records created by mistake. For people who have left, change their status instead.

1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Open the employee's profile.
3. Select **More**, then **Delete employee**.
4. Type the employee's name to confirm.
5. Select **Delete permanently**.

Employees with payslips cannot be deleted.

title: Add a note to an employee record
aliases: write a note on someone's profile
log a note about an employee
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Open the employee's profile.
3. Select the **Notes** tab.
4. Select **Add note**.
5. Type your note and choose who can see it.
6. Select **Save**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Export the employee list to CSV
aliases: get employee details as a file
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Use **Filter** to narrow the list if needed.
3. Select **Export**.
4. Choose **CSV** and tick the columns to include.
5. Select **Download**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Change an employee's status
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Open the employee's profile.
3. Select **Change status**.
4. Choose **Active**, **On leave** or **Inactive**.
5. Enter the **Effective date**.
6. Select **Save**.

Inactive employees are left out of new pay runs and cannot sign in.

title: Add a department
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Company**.
2. Select **Departments**, then **Add department**.
3. Enter a **Name**.
4. Choose a **Department head**.
5. Select **Save**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**. Changes take effect immediately, and you can undo them at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Update the company logo
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Company**.
2. Select **Branding**.
3. Select **Upload logo**.
4. Choose a PNG or JPG file, at least 400 pixels wide.
5. Select **Save**.

The new logo appears on payslips and emails sent from now on.

title: Update company details
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Company**.
2. Select **Company details**.
3. Select **Edit**.
4. Update the **Legal name**, **ABN** or **Address**.
5. Select **Save**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**. Changes take effect immediately, and you can undo them at any time by repeating the steps.

title: Invite an administrator
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Users**.
2. Select **Invite user**.
3. Enter their **Email**.
4. Choose the **Role**, such as **Payroll admin** or **HR admin**.
5. Select **Send invitation**.

The invitation link expires after seven days.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Change a user's permissions
aliases: restrict what a user can see
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Users**.
2. Open the user.
3. Select **Edit role**.
4. Choose a different **Role**, or select **Custom** to tick individual permissions.
5. Select **Save**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Reset an employee's password
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Open the employee's profile.
3. Select **More**, then **Send password reset**.
4. Confirm by selecting **Send**.

The employee receives an email with a link that works for 24 hours.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Set public holidays
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Calendar**.
2. Select **Public holidays**.
3. Choose your **State or region** to load the standard holidays.
4. Select **Add holiday** to enter a custom day.
5. Select **Save**.

The change is recorded in the audit history under **Settings**.

title: Import employees from a CSV file
body:
1. Go to **People** and select **Employees**.
2. Select **Import**.
3. Select **Download template** and fill it in.
4. Select **Upload file** and choose your CSV.
5. Match any columns that are not recognised.
6. Select **Import**.

Rows with errors are listed so you can fix them and try again.

title: Turn on two-step verification
aliases: require a code when signing in
body:
1. Go to **Settings** and select **Security**.
2. Under **Two-step verification**, select **Turn on**.
3. Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
4. Enter the six-digit code.
5. Select **Verify**.

Select **Require for all users** to make it mandatory for your company.

title: Add a deduction to an employee's pay
body:
1. Go to **People** and open the employee's profile.
2. Select the **Pay** tab, then **Pay items**.
3. Select **Add pay item**.
4. Choose the **Deduction** category and pick the item, such as **Union fees**.
5. Enter the **Amount** and how often it is taken.
6. Set the **Start date** and, if needed, an **End date**.
7. Select **Save**.

Deductions appear on the employee's payslip from the next pay run.
